data.one_liner: Integrate audio and video calling or live video streaming APIs into your app.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive toolkit for building real-time audio and video calling applications. Supports features like HLS streaming, RTMP live streaming, screen sharing, transcription, whiteboard, and custom media relays.
use_when: You need to build a video conferencing or audio calling app for Android and iOS.
You require advanced media features like recording, simulcast, and screen sharing.
avoid_when: Your app targets Web, macOS, or Windows (version 5.0 drops support for these platforms).
You only need local media playback rather than live communication.
strengths: Rich set of out-of-the-box features including screen sharing, whiteboard, and transcription.
Actively maintained with frequent updates and bug fixes.
weaknesses: Web, macOS, and Windows are not supported in version 5.0.
Requires significant platform-specific setup (Java 17, min SDK updates, Swift Package Manager, and iOS extensions for screen sharing).
data.setup_notes: Requires Android configuration for Java 17, minimum SDK 23, compile/target SDK 36, and internet/camera/microphone permissions in AndroidManifest.xml. iOS requires deployment target 13.0, Swift Package Manager support enabled, camera/microphone usage descriptions in Info.plist, and a Broadcast Upload Extension for screen sharing.
